statement: The Google-Blackstone TPU compute joint venture faces site-level execution delays that put its 500 megawatt by 2027 target at risk.
why: A stalled TPU-based capacity build slows the arrival of non-merchant accelerator capacity that would otherwise compete with GPU cloud supply.

impact.mechanism: Delayed data-center sites push out planned TPU capacity, leaving compute demand to be served by existing GPU supply for longer.

confidence.basis: Secondary summary of Bloomberg reporting that could not be fetched directly; no cause of delay specified.

dispersion: Source does not say whether the delay is permitting, power, equipment lead times or chip availability.
